facts.value: Study advisory offers support and advice on various study-related questions.
E! Week with its mentoring program is ideal for all Bachelor's students starting their studies.
In a three-day program, first semester students learn about Goethe University, the department, campus life, and the city of Frankfurt.
Bachelor meets Business invites an exciting selection of companies each winter semester. Master's students are also welcome.
Dean's List aims to honor outstanding academic achievements while facilitating exchanges between students and companies.
This special honor from the dean is awarded every semester to the best Bachelor and Master students.
Website provides information about the work, current projects, and engagement opportunities in student initiatives and the Wiwi student council.
Graduation celebration traditionally celebrates the completion of studies with gowns.
